# BilloAI

> After you network, know who from the room is worth staying connected to.

BilloAI is a web app for people who just left a conference, mixer, or trade show. You name why you went, save who you met (card, name, or link, plus one line), and see who actually matches that goal. A draft note is written for you. You copy it. Nothing sends itself.

## Product rules

- Card photos are read and discarded. They are not stored.
- Follow-ups never send themselves.
- A group or Team admin can see who used a seat (name, email, activity counts). They never see who that person met, notes, or drafts.
- Group seats are $6 once, for one named event. Unused seats do not move to the next event.
- Team seats are $150/seat/year (or $15/month), minimum 5, from $750 a year. Year-round matching. Admin sets a company hunt. Teammates see a nameless “already in play” badge, never contact names.
- Individual is $19/month or $180/year after the first included event.
- First event matching is included on a free account.
